Ben — forwarding Polaris thread. They see a 550 bounce from the SMS provider. Attachments are in the drive link below and included in Alex's email. Repro steps are in the first message.

What I suspect: delegated-invite path sets sender_id=tenant_alias which may not be registered with the SMS provider for the destination MNO. If the provider rewrites the sender (or strips required headers), some carriers will reject with 550. Also double-check our rate-limiting / dedupe logic on the redis queue — we've seen a case where provider TTL + dedupe resulted in a silent drop when the message ID changed.

- Pull relay logs for 2027-05-30 13:10:00Z +/- 5 minutes for outbound messages to +1-202-555-0142 and alex@polaris-supplies.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Polaris: invite acceptance failing — OTP not arriving

Quick update — root cause and temporary mitigation applied. Summary below.

Root cause: SMS provider rejected the outbound because the delegated sender_id (tenant_alias=polaris_alias) was not validated for the destination carrier. Provider returned 550 with "Unregistered Sender ID" and an internal carrier code X-CR: 301. Email OTPs were delivered but the portal attempted SMS first (UI shows "OTP sent").

What I did: 
- Confirmed the outbound relay entry for +1-202-555-0142 at 2027-05-30T13:11:23Z (relay-id rly-9921).
- Reissued a new invite using sender_id=redwood-default and forced email-first delivery for the token.
- Updated SUP-4321 with logs and a note for our SMS provider to register polaris_alias (follow-up action).

Request for Polaris: please try the new invite I reissued (you should have received an email-only invite at 13:58 UTC). If SMS is still required we'll coordinate with the provider to register the tenant sender.

Permanent fix plan: 
- Short term (today): UI change to show explicit channel (Email or SMS) and fallback log in the invite flow so customers know which channel was used.
- Medium term: automate sender_id registration flow for delegated tenants or restrict delegation unless sender_id is pre-registered. Engineering ticket created (ENG-1159).

Thanks for the quick triage on this one — good catch by Polaris on grabbing the provider bounce headers.

Ben Carter
Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
